- 603 Multicolour LEDs

## Information
Create a standout festive display with this colourful Santa, Reindeer and Snowman Infinity Light. Featuring a fun Christmas trio and a striking 3D infinity effect, it makes an eye-catching addition to indoor or outdoor seasonal décor. Standing 90cm tall, the lightweight frame is illuminated by 603 multicoloured SMD LEDs, creating the illusion of lights continuing endlessly into the distance. The fully 360° design allows the display to be enjoyed from different angles, while the included metal base and support ropes make it easy to position as a freestanding decoration. A generous 8m clear lead cable offers plenty of flexibility when setting up your display. The built-in timer provides added convenience, automatically illuminating the decoration for 6 hours before switching off for 18 hours and repeating the same cycle each day. IP44 rated for indoor and outdoor use, this festive infinity light is ideal for living rooms, hallways, porches, patios and Christmas garden displays. It can also be wall mounted if preferred, although wall fixings are not included. Please note: When used outdoors, the transformer must be kept indoors or placed inside a suitable weatherproof enclosure. If wall mounted, bring the decoration indoors during periods of high winds.

Classic Warm micro LED black metal frame light ball 28cm with gold centre bauble. ENCHANTING LIGHT BALL - Bring a touch of luxury and modern festive elegance to your Christmas decor with this black metal LED Sphere Ball Frame, complete with a stunning 14cm gold bauble which can be suspended at its centre. Combining sleek contemporary design with classic seasonal charm, this decorative piece creates a dazzling focal point for mantels, tables, consoles, or entrance displays. ELEGANT DESIGN - The minimalist black metal frame combined with delicate black wiring gives this light ball a sleek and contemporary look, making it a standout piece in any setting. A large 14cm elegant gold bauble ready to hang elegantly inside the frame, creating a floating effect for a dramatic, eye-catching centrepiece. WARM GLOW - The 192 classic warm micro LEDs provide a soft, inviting light that adds a festive glow to your home, garden, or event space. Perfect for creating a cosy and warm holiday ambiance both indoors and outdoors. In addition to Christmas and holiday decor, this light ball is perfect for weddings, parties, outdoor gatherings, or any event where you want to add a touch of magic and sparkle to your setting. INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE - Whether you want to place it in your living room, use it as a centerpiece on your dining table, or hang it on your patio or garden to illuminate outdoor spaces, this light ball is designed to withstand both indoor and outdoor conditions, making it perfect for all settings. TIMER FUNCTION - The built in timer allows the lights to stay on for 8 hours and automatically turn off for 16 hours. EASY OPERATION - With its 8M silver cable you will have plenty of length to position the light ball exactly where you want it. Perfect for weddings, parties, outdoor gatherings, or any event where you want to add a touch of magic and sparkle to your setting. Assembly is required to attach the bauble inside the frame light.
